description.value: Hišimy̓awiƛ (5040 Alpine Hut) is a backcountry alpine hut on Vancouver Island operated by the Alpine Club of Canada's Vancouver Island Chapter, bearing both its Indigenous name and a reference to the 5040 peak. It sits in remote mountain terrain, making it an unusual and adventurous overnight option for cyclists exploring the island's backcountry. A fee applies for stays, consistent with ACC hut booking practices.
